description: This file defines the HtmlErrorRenderer class in the Slim framework; it handles rendering error pages as HTML, including detailed exception information when enabled.

classes.name: HtmlErrorRenderer
classes.description: A renderer class that generates HTML error pages, optionally including detailed exception information based on configuration.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Handles rendering the error as an HTML string, displaying detailed info if enabled.

methods.name: renderExceptionFragment
methods.description: Generates an HTML fragment with detailed exception information including type, code, message, file, line, and trace.

methods.name: renderHtmlBody
methods.description: Constructs the complete HTML document with a given title and body content.
